description: Interações farmacodinâmicas (efeitos que se somam), por fato ou classe. Simétricas: valem para qualquer par de medicamentos que tenha um participante de cada lado.

sources.quote: Starting PROZAC in a patient who is being treated with MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue is also contraindicated because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome
The concomitant use of monoamine oxidase inhibiting compounds is contraindicated.
The use of MAOIs (intended to treat psychiatric disorders) concomitantly with Wellbutrin XL or within 14 days of discontinuing treatment with Wellbutrin XL is contraindicated.
Linezolid is a reversible, nonselective inhibitor of monoamine oxidase
sources.note: Seção 4.2: "Linezolid should not be used in patients taking any medicinal product which inhibits monoamine oxidases A or B (e.g., phenelzine, isocarboxazid) or within two weeks of taking any such medicinal product."

sources.quote: The risk is increased with concomitant use of other serotonergic drugs (including triptans, tricyclic antidepressants, fentanyl, lithium, tramadol, tryptophan, meperidine, methadone, buspirone, amphetamines, and St. John's Wort)
Avoid the concomitant use of drugs known to prolong the QT interval.

sources.locator: Boxed warning: Risks from concomitant use with opioids
sources.quote: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

sources.locator: seção 7 Drug Interactions (Benzodiazepines and Other CNS Depressants)
sources.quote: Due to additive pharmacologic effect, the concomitant use of benzodiazepines or other CNS depressants, including alcohol, increases the risk of respiratory depression, profound sedation, coma, and death.

sources.locator: seção 5.2 CNS-Depressant Effects and Next-Day Impairment
sources.quote: Coadministration with other CNS depressants (e.g., benzodiazepines, opioids, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol) increases the risk of CNS depression
warfarin, and other anti-coagulants may add to this risk
sources.note: Frase completa: o uso com aspirina, anti-inflamatórios não esteroides, varfarina e outros anticoagulantes pode somar ao risco.
